title: [29.x][ALL-E] Document Type is Quote in Document Attachment table (1173) after posting a Sales Invoice with attachmentsIntial Commit
summary: Document attachments transferred after posting a sales invoice or credit memo now correctly retain the posted document type instead of being incorrectly set to Quote.
key_points: Attachment transfers during document posting were clearing the document type field, defaulting to Quote enum value 0
Logic updated to explicitly set document type based on the posted document table
Posted invoice attachments now have Invoice type, posted credit memos have Credit Memo type
Regression tests added to verify correct document type assignment for both header and line attachments
quote: Document Type was cleared. Because Quote is enum value 0, clearing the field implicitly assigned Quote.
